<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Company" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_COMPANY" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>identify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_PROCUREMENT" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>rfp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>evaluate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>visitsQ</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>visits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mergeV</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>select</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mergeN</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>negotiate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>agreeQ</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>onboard</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SUPPLIER" name="Supplier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Need for a new supplier identified" />
    <bpmn:task id="identify" name="Identify the need for a new supplier" />
    <bpmn:task id="rfp" name="Issue the request for proposals" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit" name="Submit the proposal" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluate" name="Evaluate each proposal on cost, quality and delivery time" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="visitsQ" name="Site visits or interviews needed?" />
    <bpmn:task id="visits" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="mergeV" />
    <bpmn:task id="select" name="Select a supplier" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="mergeN" />
    <bpmn:task id="negotiate" name="Negotiate the contract terms" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="agreeQ" name="Both parties agree on the terms?" />
    <bpmn:task id="sign" name="Sign the contract" />
    <bpmn:task id="onboard" name="Onboard the supplier and execute the contract" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="identify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="identify" targetRef="rfp" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="rfp" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="submit" targetRef="evaluate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="evaluate" targetRef="visitsQ" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="yes" sourceRef="visitsQ" targetRef="visits" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="no" sourceRef="visitsQ" targetRef="mergeV" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="visits" targetRef="mergeV" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="mergeV" targetRef="select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="select" targetRef="mergeN" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="mergeN" targetRef="negotiate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="negotiate" targetRef="agreeQ" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="yes" sourceRef="agreeQ" targetRef="sign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="no" sourceRef="agreeQ" targetRef="mergeN" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="sign" targetRef="onboard" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="onboard" targetRef="end" />

</bpmn:definitions>
